concepts.gloss_en: the radiating/shining of the light of the merit of the forefathers (zechut avot)

members.note: representative; nominal form of the phenomenon
verbal form ('the light... shines') of the same phenomenon, same Torah lm1:55, same referent
same verbal form with temporal prefix כש- ('when...'); identical referent in lm1:55

notes: All three are grammatical variants (noun vs verb vs verb-with-temporal-prefix) of one and the same phenomenon within a single Torah; they name the same conceptual event, not distinct concepts.
